verdict.rationale: Managing models, prompts, and configs is a fair question for a local LLM runner. However, the evidence shows no central library or manager for downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model settings. The closest item is that each llamafile bundles its own weights and default arguments into a single file. That is a packaging format, not a management interface, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
